title: Real-Time Analytics
summary: Real-time analytics turns a firehose of user events into dashboards that are seconds old. Events are collected and appended to a durable log. A stream processor aggregates them in time windows, handling events that arrive late or out of order, and loads the results into a column-oriented OLAP store built to answer slice-and-dice queries in under a second. Raw events are kept in a data lake for reprocessing and deep analysis.

walkthrough.title: Track events
walkthrough.text: SDKs in web and mobile apps send events such as page_view and add_to_cart with user, session, device, and timestamp, batched to save battery and bandwidth.

walkthrough.title: Collect and validate
walkthrough.text: Collectors validate the schema, drop bots, add geo and campaign data, and append events to Kafka, partitioned by user so each user's events stay in order.

walkthrough.title: Aggregate in windows
walkthrough.text: A stream processor computes per-minute counts, unique users (HyperLogLog), and funnels. Watermarks decide how long to wait for late events before closing a window.

walkthrough.title: Archive raw events
walkthrough.text: Every raw event is also written to the data lake as Parquet. This is the replayable source for backfills, fixes, and new metrics.

walkthrough.title: Load the OLAP store
walkthrough.text: Rollups stream into a columnar OLAP database (Druid, Pinot, ClickHouse) that is indexed by time and dimensions.

walkthrough.title: Serve live dashboards
walkthrough.text: Dashboards query 'signups by country, last 30 minutes' and get answers in under a second, refreshed every few seconds.

walkthrough.title: Explore full history
walkthrough.text: Analysts run ad-hoc SQL over months of raw events in the lake for questions the rollups did not anticipate.

data.label: Tracking SDKs

output.name: Events
output.type: { event, userId, anonId, props, ts } batched

responsibilities: Capture events with a consistent, versioned schema.
Batch, compress, and retry with local buffering.
Respect consent settings before tracking.

failureModes.mitigation: First-party collection domain; send key events server-side.

failureModes.impact: Metrics that cannot be trusted or joined.
failureModes.mitigation: Tracking plan with schema registry and CI validation.

data.label: Event Collector
responsibilities: Accepts very high event volume and acknowledges quickly.
Validates, filters bots, and enriches with geo and campaign data.
Routes invalid events to a quarantine topic, not the bin.

failureModes.mitigation: Autoscaling with headroom; clients retry with backoff.

failureModes.impact: A new app version's events are all rejected.
failureModes.mitigation: Quarantine and alert; backward-compatible schema evolution.

data.label: Event Log

output.name: Consumers
output.type: Stream processor, lake sink, other teams

responsibilities: Buffers and durably stores events between producers and consumers.
Lets many consumers read the same stream independently.
Allows replay for a retention window.

failureModes.mitigation: Lag alerts; lake sink as the long-term copy.

data.label: Stream Processor

input.name: Events
input.type: Ordered per partition, late arrivals possible

responsibilities: Aggregates by event time, not arrival time.
Uses watermarks to bound how long to wait for late events.
Checkpoints state for exactly-once results.

failureModes.mitigation: Allowed lateness with updates; correct later from the lake.

data.label: Raw Event Lake
responsibilities: Keeps the complete raw history cheaply.
Is the source for backfills and reprocessing.
Supports ad-hoc SQL and ML feature building.

failureModes.mitigation: Pseudonymise IDs; deletion pipelines; retention limits.

data.label: Real-Time OLAP Store

output.name: Query results
output.type: GROUP BY country over last 30 min in < 1 s

responsibilities: Answers filter-and-aggregate queries in sub-second time.
Makes streamed data queryable within seconds.
Partitions by time for fast recent-data queries.

failureModes.mitigation: Normalise dimensions; keep raw detail in the lake.
Query quotas, result caching, pre-aggregated tables.

data.label: Dashboards & Analysts

output.name: Insight
output.type: Live KPIs, funnels, alerts, ad-hoc answers

responsibilities: Show live product and business metrics.
Alert on sudden drops (checkout broken?).
Support deep dives over full history.

failureModes.mitigation: Shared metric definitions; label data freshness; reconcile daily.

failureModes.impact: Conflicting versions of the same metric.
